params.body:
The Studio's Together preset no longer worked. This removes it and the note under it.

## Why

- **The preset did nothing.** It set all four Studio phases to DeepSeek V4 Pro. Together took that model off serverless on 2026-08-27, and the pipeline's catalog dropped it. A saved choice is now discarded on the next load, so pressing the button left Studio on Claude without saying so.
- **The note was wrong.** It named Llama 3.3 70B and Qwen 2.5 72B, neither of which the preset used.

## What changes

- The `together` entry is removed from `STUDIO_PRESETS`, with a comment saying when a second preset should come back.
- The note under the buttons is removed.

## How it was tested

- `npm run build` passes.
- `eslint` reports one error, at line 83 (an empty `catch`). It is the same on main and is not part of this change.

## For review

The remaining "Claude (subscription)" preset puts `content-write` on Sonnet 5. The pipeline's default is Opus 5.5. Pressing the button therefore moves Studio drafts from Opus to Sonnet. That is a product decision, so this PR leaves it as it is.
params.title: Remove the Studio's Together preset: its model left Together, so the button changed nothing
